ModMetaData.name: Automatic Outfit Manager
ModMetaData.author: tekmojo
ModMetaData.description:
Automatically manage apparel, weapons and access for Work and Non-Work Areas. Set work outfits, restore saved personal outfits, and choose fallback gear. Optional locker rooms, task buffers and storage filters keep outfits organized.
Supports vanilla and modded apparel and primary weapons.
